source.organization: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (経済産業省)

transport.rate_limit: per gBizINFO terms; returns 500 without token

parsing.notes: Send free token via X-hojinInfo-api-token header. Detail at /hojin/v1/hojin/{corporate_number}; sub-resources /finance /procurement /subsidy /certification /patent /workplace. Bulk CSV at /hojin/DownloadTop. Returns 500 without token.

mapping_rules.incorporation_date: date_of_establishment (authoritative founding date; preferred over NTA assignmentDate).
mapping_rules.activity: business_summary + business_items[] (closest to an industry code).
mapping_rules.financials: finance[] as a lighter supplement; prefer EDINET XBRL when the company is a filer.

fixture_requirements: basic record (name, location, establishment, capital, employees)
record with only basic info (sparse coverage)

live_test_plan.smoke: With a free GBIZINFO_API_TOKEN, fetch one corporate_number detail + /finance.
live_test_plan.full: Enrich the NTA universe by corporate_number; gate behind env and respect rate limits.

blockers: REST API requires a free token (利用申請 → APIトークン); returns 500 without it.
Per-dataset coverage varies; many companies have only basic info.
